title: Caldo Verde
description: Smooth potato soup with ribbons of collard greens cut fine as grass, served with slices of smoky chouriço and a thread of olive oil.
notes: Kale works if you cannot find collards. Spanish chorizo is a fair stand-in for chouriço.

steps.text: Soften the onion and garlic in half the olive oil.
Add the potatoes, water, and salt and simmer until the potatoes collapse.
Meanwhile, fry the chouriço slices in a dry pan until the fat runs.
Roll the collard greens into a tight cigar and slice as thinly as you can, then add them to the simmering soup and cook just until bright green.
steps.tip: The ribbons should be like fine grass. Thick strips make a cabbage soup.

steps.text: Serve with a few slices of chouriço in each bowl, a thread of the remaining olive oil, and black pepper.
